in_marathi.name: Hemendra
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hemendra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Hemendra is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'hema' (gold) and 'dra' (treasure). This name signifies the one who is a treasure of gods or possesses wealth in terms of wisdom and knowledge. It is believed that a person named Hemendra is blessed with prosperity and good fortune.
